arabic text: IS BAAT SE MEHSOOS KARO KIA HAI SAKINA (A.S)
english translation text: REALIZE WHO SAKINA IS WITH THE FACT THAT

arabic text: ABBAS (A.S) KE HONTON KA QASEEDA HAI SAKINA (A.S)
english translation text: THE LIPS OF ABBAS IS PRAISING SAKINA

arabic text: AAINA-E-ZEHRA (A.S) MEIN JO DEKHA TERA BACHPAN
english translation text: IN THE MIRROR OF ZEHRA WHEN WE SEE YOUR CHILDHOOD

arabic text: HAR AKS PUKARA KE TU ZEHRA HAI SAKINA(A.S)
english translation text: EVERY MOMENT SAID THAT YOU ARE ZEHRA, OH SAKINA

arabic text: JO PYAS KE PARCHAM KI ALAMDAR HAI AB TAK
english translation text: HE WHO IS STILL THE FLAG BEARER OF THIRST

arabic text: ABBAS(A.S) KI WOH PYARI SAKINA HAI SAKINA (A.S)
english translation text: SAKINA IS THE BELOVED OF ABBAS

arabic text: ABBAS(A.S) KI NAZRON SE KOI PARH KE TAU DEKHAY
english translation text: LOOK FROM ABBAS'S POINT OF VIEW

arabic text: EHSAAS KI EK NEHJ-E-BALAGHA HAI SAKINA(A.S)
english translation text: YOU WILL FEEL THAT SAKINA IS NAHJUL BALAGHA

arabic text: JO MASHQ MEIN BHAR SAKTA HAI DUNYA KE SAMANDAR
english translation text: HE WHO CAN FILL THE MASHK WITH THE OCEANS OF THE WORLD

arabic text: KAUNAIN MEIN BAS WOH TERA SAQQA HAI SAKINA(A.S)
english translation text: HE IS YOUR WATER CARRIER, OH SAKINA

arabic text: HAR UMR KE HAIDER NE JHULAYA TERA JHOOLA
YEH AUJ FAQAT TU NE HI PAYA HAI SAKINA (A.S)
english translation text: ONLY YOU HAVE ATTAINED THIS STATUS, OH SAKINA

arabic text: ISS BAAT SE MEHSOOS KARO KYA HAI SAKINA.\nABBAS KE HONTON KA QASEEDA HAI SAKINA.\nABU FADHAL ABBAS SA & SAKINA SA
english translation text: CAN YOU COMPREHEND OR FATHOM WHO IS SAKINA\nABBAS’S LIPS ARE IN PRAISE, FOR SAKINA

arabic text: AAEENA-E-ZEHRA MEIN JO DEKHA TERA BACHPAN.\nHAR AKS PUKAARA KE TU ZEHRA HAI SAKINA.\nO SAKINA
english translation text: IN ZAHRA’S MIRROR, IF EVER YOUR CHILDHOOD WAS VIEWED\nEVERY REFLECTION WOULD CALL OUT ‘YOU ARE ZAHRA!’

arabic text: DARYAAON KE LAB NOKAY QALAM CHOOM RAHAY HAIN.\nMAINE ABHI LIKHA NAHI SOCHA HAI SAKINA.
english translation text: THE LIPS OF RIVERS ARE KISSING THE NIB OF MY PEN\nALTHOUGH I HAVE NOT WRITTEN ANYTHING YET, JUST ONLY THOUGHT OF SAKINA

arabic text: REHAAN KE SURAT WOH SAR AFRAAZ RAHEGA.\nJISNE TERI DEHLEEZ KO CHOOMA HAI SAKINA
english translation text: LIKE REHAN (POET), HE TOO WILL REMAIN EXALTED\nWHOM SO EVER HAS KISSED YOUR MOSELEUM, O SAKINA
